attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a single 4:5 portrait photorealistic rehabilitation exercise step photograph, Farmer's Carry starting position, no graphic layout.
Input images: Images 1, 2 and 3 are identity, wardrobe and photography references of the SAME woman; preserve her face, age, skin tone, black ponytail, fitted plain white short sleeve T-shirt, dark gray long athletic pants. Transform the reference into this new full body rehabilitation photograph; do not reuse its raised arm pose.
Scene: gray-blue seamless studio background and matching flat gray-blue stable floor, soft diffuse studio lighting, natural contact shadows. A single sturdy rectangular dark gray placement platform with a light gray flat top, about 60–65 cm high and wide enough for TWO small kettlebells side by side, stands at image right slightly behind the subject, leaving the flat foreground walking route completely unobstructed. Platform must be fully visible and is the fixed placement location in all four steps. No other props.
Subject and action: same referenced adult East Asian woman, full head to shoes, standing still near center-left, torso and pelvis naturally upright, chest facing camera in a mild three-quarter front view angled 20 degrees towards image right. Both feet hip width apart, both white low-top unbranded athletic shoes planted flat on the floor. Shoulders relaxed and level, elbows naturally extended, wrists neutral. Her LEFT hand and RIGHT hand each firmly wrap around the top handle of one lightweight matte BLACK kettlebell; exactly TWO identical kettlebells of the same shape and size, one hanging vertically at each side close to the thighs without touching the legs. Show both handle grips and both bells clearly, neither hand is empty. Head upright and neutral expression, gaze forward along the route. No raised shoulders, no leaning sideways, no exaggerated rigid posture.
Camera and framing: fixed front-three-quarter full body camera with natural medium-lens perspective, horizontal level, portrait 4:5. Entire head, both hands, both kettlebells, both legs and both shoes visible with modest margins. Keep woman about 75% of image height, floor baseline and composition that can be reused unchanged for walking and turning. Reserve space at image right for the platform and subsequent approach.
Constraints: one person, one frozen starting pose, anatomical hands and limbs, exact two matched kettlebells, stable flat floor, realistic weight-bearing. No text, numbers, arrows, labels, logos, watermark, ghosting, montage, collage or split panels.
